title: Benchmarking cell-type deconvolution in cross-platform transcriptomic data.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 19677865 file listing via API: Data.zip 2.80 GB, intermediate_data.zip 3.02 GB, manuscript.zip 390 MB, scripts.zip 3.1 MB, Results.zip 2.6 MB, README (read in full). GEO series text for GSE271255, GSE338144 and GSE338314: the new data is 4 brain-tumour specimens, 13 GeoMx regions (9 immune aggregates, 4 tumour regions) plus Visium on the same blocks; raw files withheld for privacy. Did not download the zips (all data zips are over the 50 MB cap).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the only measured ground truth is pathologist-counted B and T cells from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) for 28 GeoMx regions from 10 glioma patients; all other ground-truth proportions come from simulated pseudo-bulk mixtures built from public PBMC and bone-marrow single-cell data.

a1_downloadable.note: Zenodo (CC BY 4.0) and GEO processed files are open; checked listings only, not contents.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Cell-type proportions for most samples are constructed by the authors' own pseudo-bulk simulation; the real cross-platform pairs (GeoMx vs Visium) have no measured truth. Based on README and paper text.

a3_inputs_present.note: Expression matrices are deposited (GEO processed files, Zenodo RData), per paper and README.

a4_units_stated.note: Proportions and cell counts; TPM normalisation stated in paper.

a5_enough_rows.note: Only 28 regions from 10 patients have measured (mIF) cell counts, two cell types each; paper text, not verified in files. The new cross-platform set is 13 regions from 4 specimens (GEO).

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~6 GB zipped total; the measured subset would be MB-scale
a6_fits_laptop.note: Measured subset is small; full zips exceed the download cap.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: GEO design text (9 immune + 4 tumour regions, 4 specimens) matches paper description; not checked at file level.

a8_label_provenance.note: Simulated pseudo-bulk proportions are computed from the same single-cell data used to build deconvolution signatures, so labels are derived by construction; only the 28 mIF counts are real measurements.

existing_models.name: SpatialDecon (deconvolution tool benchmarked in this paper)
existing_models.score_and_split: Paper reports it as most consistent across simulated and real cross-platform settings; moderate correlation with mIF counts across 28 regions (exact value not extracted).
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Platform-specific technical bias still degrades cross-platform deconvolution.

existing_models.name: cell2location (Bayesian spatial deconvolution tool benchmarked here)
existing_models.score_and_split: Co-best with SpatialDecon in the paper's benchmark; numbers not extracted.

backbone.name: scGPT / Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) could embed references

controls.positive_control: Simulated pseudo-bulk mixtures with known proportions

honest_claim_h3: With 28 measured regions, a model could at most claim it estimates B and T cell fractions in glioma immune aggregates on GeoMx about as well as existing tools; everything else is fit to simulation.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use spatial gene-expression profiles from two platforms to predict the fraction of each cell type in a tissue region.
plain_idea.train_on: Simulated mixtures of single-cell profiles (count unknown, inside a 3 GB zip) plus 13 matched real regions on two platforms.
plain_idea.predict: Cell-type proportions; real truth exists only as pathologist mIF (multiplex immunofluorescence) counts of B and T cells in 28 regions.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Spatial labs choosing a deconvolution tool would benefit, but the paper already delivers that guidance and the measured truth is too thin to train on.

more_or_better_data.why: 28 measured regions versus the many simulated and public benchmarks deconvolution tools already use.

confidence_score.why: No replicate measured truth to calibrate against.

models_beatable.why: Tools are open and the paper shows cross-platform weakness, but 28 truth points cannot show a win.

guaranteed_improvement.why: No new data measuring the same truth the same way joins to this set.

ml_idea: Learn a platform-bias correction for deconvolution; dead because measured ground truth is 28 regions and the rest is self-simulated.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from Zenodo zip sizes only; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count regions with measured (non-simulated) cell proportions: paper says 28, which already kills it.

verdict_reason: Benchmark paper: only 28 regions (10 patients) have measured cell counts; all other labels are simulated pseudo-bulk mixtures built from the same reference data (A2, A5, A8 fail).
